license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so these weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks only that you keep the copyright notice and license text with any copy you redistribute, and it places no obligation on your own application code. The official ResDCN-18 and DLA-34 COCO checkpoints were published by the MIT-licensed CenterNet project but carry no separate per-checkpoint license file; LibreYOLO's mirror states MIT as implied by the releasing project rather than a publisher-confirmed, checkpoint-specific grant.
